flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi (cronservice): workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService and services/datahive/nricFinUenDataRetrieval (receiving board data); workflows/furnish_processing/helpers/FurnishApprovalHelper (the only place the stage is reset to RD1, from a hirer furnish); agencies/toppan/upload/{models/ToppanStage,helpers/ToppanUploadHelper,jobs/ToppanUploadJob} (RD1 letter); crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository; application-prod.properties. Other repos: no code specific to this story.
note: The story asks that once the individual Director/Partner particulars are received, OCMS reverts the NOPO to the 1st reminder (RD1) with the Director/Partner as the vehicle owner. No code does this from DataHive data: no offender or stage change happens after the UEN sync (see OCMS11.18). The only similar mechanism is FurnishApprovalHelper.changeProcessingStage, which resets the stage to RD1 when a hirer furnish is approved; that is the furnish flow, not an ACRA Director/Partner, so it is not counted. Toppan RD1 letter generation exists but is generic, and the SFTP upload to Toppan is blocked at application-prod.properties:86 (OCMS-DF-2026-192). Sheet status: Demo paid (50% of 75%); the demo_remark mentions SFTP and Code Split. No relevant ticket other than OCMS-DF-2026-192.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. No code reverts the NOPO to RD1 for a Director/Partner from ACRA data; only the generic RD1 letter exists. Ask URA where this feature was built or mark a gap.

steps.step: Individual Director/Partner particulars have been received from the data source
steps.detail: The board response is parsed into BoardInfo with personIdNo, positionHeldCode, positionAppointmentDate, positionWithdrawnDate and referencePeriod (DataHiveUENBatchService.java:483-502, UENDataResult.java:88-101). There is no person name or address, and no selection of Director/Partner by appointment period. Same fit as OCMS11.18 step 2 and OCMS11.20 step 1.

steps.step: NOPO is reverted to the 1st reminder (RD1) with the Director/Partner as owner
steps.detail: After the UEN sync there is no change of next_processing_stage or offender (DataHiveUenFinService.java:1479-1485; only noticeNo is written to ocms_nro_temp). The only reset to RD1 is at FurnishApprovalHelper.java:644-651, triggered by approval of a hirer furnish, not by Director/Partner data from ACRA. That flow is a similar mechanism but is not connected to DataHive.

steps.step: Director/Partner is recorded as the vehicle owner with a letter address
steps.detail: Nothing writes the Director/Partner as the offender in ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver or their letter address from the UEN flow: board data is not written to DB (DataHiveUenFinService.java:1470-1477) and only shareholders are stored (:1440-1447). Inserting an ONOD_ADDR row for a new person exists only in the furnish flow (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:622-637).

steps.step: 1st reminder (RD1) is built and sent to the Director/Partner
steps.detail: A generic RD1 letter generation exists: findToppanNoticesForStage selects notices with next_processing_stage = 'RD1' for offender_indicator 'Y' (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:584-611; ToppanUploadHelper.java:1887), so the letter goes to the recorded offender; since the Director/Partner is never recorded as the offender (step 3), they would not receive the letter. Also sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan at application-prod.properties:86 and the delivery gate is bypassed (ToppanUploadJob.java:420-430, OCMS-DF-2026-192), so the letter does not reach Toppan in the repo configuration.
